title: Name and Point to Feelings
adult_setup: Print and cut large cards before the child arrives
steps: Show two cards; name one feeling; invite pointing; accept any response
safety_limits: Adult supervision; cards larger than the child's palm; no loose small pieces

title: Cozy Corner Choice
adult_setup: Place two familiar items in a clear space
steps: Offer two choices; sit nearby; use one short phrase; end when child signals done
safety_limits: Use only familiar age-rated items; never restrain the child

title: Roll the Ball Turn-Taking
adult_setup: Clear floor space and mark two sitting spots
steps: Adult rolls first; each child takes a turn; name whose turn; stop while play is positive
safety_limits: Ball must be too large to swallow; constant adult supervision

title: First-Then Picture Pair
adult_setup: Choose one current task and one preferred next activity
steps: Show first picture; show then picture; use the same short phrase; praise transition effort
safety_limits: Adult handles all cutting; use large intact cards

title: Copy My Calm Breath
steps: Adult models a slow pretend candle blow; child copies if willing; repeat up to three times
safety_limits: Stop if uncomfortable; no claim that breathing treats a condition

title: Feelings Match and Circle
steps: Read one short situation; offer two choices; child circles a face; discuss without correcting feelings
safety_limits: Use washable non-toxic drawing tools; supervise

title: Two-Choice Bedtime Sequence
adult_setup: Adult selects two safe choices and prepares cards
steps: Name the fixed bedtime step; offer two choices for order; follow the chosen sequence; note what happened
safety_limits: Choices cannot remove required safety or care steps

title: Stuffed-Toy Gentle Hands
purpose: Practice gentle touch through pretend play
steps: Model gentle touch; invite imitation; name gentle hands; end with a simple success
safety_limits: Not a response to current danger or injury; adult supervises

title: Large Shape Pasting
materials: Large paper shapes; non-toxic glue stick
adult_setup: Adult cuts every shape larger than the child's palm
steps: Adult applies glue; child places one shape; name the shape; stop after three to five pieces
safety_limits: No small or detachable pieces; adult controls glue and cutting; constant supervision

title: Pattern Pasting
materials: Large paper shapes; child-safe glue stick
steps: Choose a two-shape pattern; child continues it; adult prompts only as needed; display result
safety_limits: Adult performs all cutting; supervise glue use

title: Sibling Helper Choice
purpose: Create a positive shared routine role
steps: Older child chooses a role; younger child receives a simple matching action; adult thanks both; rotate next time
safety_limits: Do not force sharing or physical contact

title: Pause-and-Label Observation
purpose: Help caregiver record what happens before and after a routine
steps: Record what happened before; record observable behavior; record what helped; avoid diagnostic labels
safety_limits: For caregiver use only; not a clinical assessment

title: Large Sticker Choice Board
purpose: Offer limited choices during a routine
adult_setup: Verify stickers are age-rated and supervise setup
steps: Offer two choices; child places one sticker; complete the matching routine step; record response
safety_limits: Not for children who mouth small items; use only age-rated large stickers with constant supervision

title: Color the Routine Step
steps: Name the routine; child colors; child tells or points to what happens next; adult confirms

title: Picture Book Reset
steps: Offer book without pressure; label one picture per page; follow child's attention; finish with next-step cue
safety_limits: Board book must be intact and age-appropriate; never use to delay urgent help
